name: Cannonbolt
design: Original-series Cannonbolt: broad round bulky white body, black body markings, large golden-yellow armored plates on shoulders and back, clawed hands and feet, green eyes, Omnitrix emblem on forehead. No tail.
walk: heavy waddling biped walk, alternating planted feet; massive rounded shell balances each step
powers: Rolling strike: crouch, curl into a complete yellow armored BALL, unfold recovery
Shell slam: raise arms, slam body downward, recover
Rebound rush: crouch and armored rolling ball
ultimate: Orbit breaker: charge crouch, fully armored rolling ball, unfold recovery

name: Wildvine
design: Original-series Wildvine: green plant humanoid, ONE blue central eye, tooth-edged Venus flytrap flaps around head, FIVE long flexible vine legs, four long fingers per hand, explosive seed pods on back, Omnitrix at upper chest. Never human trousers or two ordinary legs.
walk: five flexible vine legs alternately plant, pull torso forward, lift and curl; maintain FIVE root legs
powers: Vine lash: pull vine arm back, extend long vine arm forward, recover
Seed bomb: reach toward back pod, throw seed pod gesture, recover
Root eruption: crouch then both hands press down
ultimate: Overgrowth: low charge, both vine arms spread commanding roots, recover

name: Blitzwolfer
design: Original-series Benwolf/Blitzwolfer: muscular GREY werewolf, darker grey fur mane and three furry head tendrils, long bushy grey tail, wolf muzzle that can split for sonic howl, three claws per hand/foot, green eyes, simple black-white classic suit with Omnitrix on lower stomach. NOT green Omniverse clothing.
walk: low digitigrade werewolf stalking biped gait, alternate feet with shoulder and tail counter-swing
powers: Sonic howl: inhale, split muzzle open to howl forward, recover
Claw flurry: draw claws back, rake both claws forward, recover
Predator pounce: crouch then leap with claws forward
ultimate: Moonlit howl: brace and inhale, powerful split-muzzle howl forward, recover

name: Snare-oh
design: Original-series Benmummy/Snare-oh: thin mummy alien made of yellow-beige bandages, black gaps with green seam lines, narrow green eyes in black face, tall pharaoh-like striped head shape, two arms and two legs, trailing bandage ribbons, Omnitrix on chest. Original design, no purple or gold modern armor.
walk: mummy biped walk, alternating bandage-wrapped feet and gently trailing ribbons
powers: Bandage lash: draw wrapped arm back, unfurl long connected arm ribbon forward, recover
Binding wrap: gather bandages, extend hand ribbons forward, recover
Sand rush: crouch then forward stretched body lunge
ultimate: Royal bind: gather arms, spread long bandage ribbons outward, recover

name: Frankenstrike
design: Original-series Benvicktor/Frankenstrike: large muscular Frankenstein-like alien with dark muted yellow-grey skin, black mullet hair and sideburns, stitches, TWO tall grey electrical conductor towers on back, dark gauntlets, black trousers with thin glowing green lines, white belt with Omnitrix. No modern green uniform.
walk: heavy planted biped strides, massive shoulders and twin back conductors counterbalance
powers: Lightning discharge: charge hand, thrust palm forward, recover
Charged fist: draw fist back, punch forward hard, recover
Shockwave: raise arms then slam fists downward
ultimate: Thunderstorm: brace and raise arms, both back conductors upright with arms spread overhead, recover

name: Upchuck
design: Original-series PERK Upchuck: small round light GREEN alien, pale yellowish belly/face, big wide mouth and small eyes, short limbs, black-white classic clothing, green Omnitrix emblem on back of hand. Classic Perk design, NOT brown Murk. Can extend four long tongues.
walk: short biped waddling walk, alternating little planted feet and belly counterbalance
powers: Plasma spit: inhale, open mouth wide forward, recover
Explosive burp: lean back, forceful forward open-mouth burp pose, recover
Tongue lash: open mouth then extend long connected tongues forward
ultimate: Digestive barrage: inflate belly anticipation, lean forward with wide open mouth releasing barrage, recover

name: Ditto
design: Original-series Ditto: small white humanoid Splixson, black head/upper body with white face, GREEN eyes, three black fin-like head lobes with green round nodes, black forearms and feet, white belly, chest Omnitrix. No modern green jumpsuit. One complete Ditto only per cell.
walk: springy nimble biped walking, alternating feet and opposing arm swing
powers: Double trouble: runner crouch, forward shoulder lunge, recover
Clone flurry: wind up both fists, rapid extended double punch, recover
Tag-team rush: crouch then extended forward running strike
ultimate: Multiplicity: ready low stance, wide forward double punch stance, recover

name: Eye Guy
design: Original-series Eye Guy/Opticoid: muscular pale yellow-green skin, many GREEN eyes across chest, shoulders, arms and back; large bat-like ears, face WITHOUT ordinary facial eyes, large central chest eye, black-white classic trousers, Omnitrix at waist. Not a single eyeball-headed monster.
walk: measured broad biped walking, alternate feet and relaxed multi-eyed arms
powers: Optic shot: draw forearm back, point eye-covered forearm forward, recover
Chest beam: brace arms outward, open large central chest eye facing forward, recover
Omni pulse: crouch then spread eye-covered arms
ultimate: All-seeing beam: brace, chest eye fully open with arms spread, recover

name: Way Big
design: Original-series Way Big/To'kustar: towering athletic white-and-red Ultraman-like alien, tall central head fin and cheek fins, green eyes, red geometric body markings, broad white red-edged shoulders, fin-like forearms, Omnitrix on left chest. Whole body fit at consistent arena-readable scale, no scenery.
walk: long powerful deliberate biped strides, alternate feet and opposing arms, upright giant posture
powers: Cosmic ray: wind up forearms, cross forearms into cosmic beam release, recover
Titan stomp: lift knee, stamp foot hard downward, recover
Meteor strike: pull fist back then powerful extended punch
ultimate: Cosmic judgement: arms charge apart, crossed forearms beam release, recover

name: Arctiguana
design: Original-series Arctiguana/Polar Manzardill: bulky BLUE iguana-like reptile, broad toothy muzzle, facial spikes, white gill fins on sides of head, THREE large blue dorsal fins along back, long thick tail, clawed feet and hands, black-white classic straps and cuffs, Omnitrix. Low quadruped stance, not a humanoid man in armor.
walk: LOW QUADRUPED reptile walk, diagonal fore/hind limbs alternate planted support, thick tail sways
powers: Frost breath: inhale with head back, open muzzle forward to exhale, recover
Ice shard: brace, open muzzle forward sharply, recover
Glacial slam: lift forequarters then slam both forelegs down
ultimate: Absolute zero: low braced inhale, wide open muzzle forward breath release, recover
